request: Sorry for the short notice, I know it's less than a week out: I need Boston to Atlanta on January 2nd for the customer's year-start planning session. Economy, cheapest available.

must_keep.quote: Whenever possible , trips should be scheduled with a minimum 7 day, and preferably with a 14 -day advance planning to maximize the opportunity to obtain lowest possible airfares.
must_keep.why: the advance-planning rule is 'whenever possible', not a ban

must_keep.quote: All airline tickets must be booked at the lowest available airfare as determined by Concur or the Travel Desk (subject to the parameters defined in this section).
must_keep.why: the default: the lowest available airfare

must_keep.quote: Our policy is that domestic air purchases are coach class, regardless of flight time, and booked via nonrefundable tickets.
must_keep.why: domestic trips are coach, whatever the flight time

distractors.quote: Air travel should be booked 14 days in advance whenever possible; at a minimum 7
distractors.why: the summary's softer restatement of the advance-planning rule

distractors.quote: Expense reports should be submitted by the traveler within 14 calendar days of completion of a trip.
distractors.why: a day count for expense reports, not for booking

design_notes: Booked on December 28 for January 2: 5 days ahead, across a month and year end. The 7-day minimum applies 'whenever possible' (lines 408-409) and is no ban, so the trip is booked at the lowest available airfare.
